evidence: I wrote the tests first and saw them fail. `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_model.py -q -k finished` gave 11 failed. `uv run --with textual --with pytest --with pytest-xdist python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -k finished -n 4` gave 7 failed, 2 passed. The 2 that passed are the two width cases of the filtered finished-effort test: they expect the "No tasks match" text the app already showed. After the change: model -k finished 11 passed, app -k finished 9 passed. Full runs: tests/test_dashboard_model.py 36 passed; tests/test_dashboard_app.py -n 4 155 passed. I ran --once against the real repo store, which only reads it. It lists dashboard-features and dashboard-bugfix first, then dashboard-ui, test-suite-speed and watch-dashboard.
observations: scripts/dashboard_model.py: EffortView.finished is a property. It is true when the effort has at least one phase or at least one task that is not withdrawn, every phase is done, and every task that is not withdrawn is done. load_snapshot runs a stable sort on finished, so live efforts come first and each group stays in subject order. scripts/dashboard_app.py: a new empty_text() shows "All N tasks done" (N = done tasks) only on the Active tab of a finished effort with no text filter. In every other case it shows "No tasks match". paint() sets the "finished" class on the effort tab, and CSS `#efforts Tab.finished { text-style: dim; }` dims it. apply() now keeps the tab order equal to the snapshot order. It finds the first pane that is out of place, removes that pane and the panes after it, re-adds them in order and restores the active tab. Filters live in app.filters, so a pane's status tab survives the rebuild. render_once styles the rule label of a finished effort dim, not bold, and its order comes from the model. render_once has no empty-state text, so I added none. Tests: a parametrized truth table for finished and a store test for the sort order. Pilot tests cover the Active empty state, the text-filter fallback, a live effort that still shows No tasks match, tab order and the dimmed class, an effort that finishes mid-session moving last and dimming, and --once order. I did not touch NeedsYouItem or _needs_you.
